newsitem.title: USA: NYS panel approves over $217 mln of bonds.
newsitem.headline: NYS panel approves over $217 mln of bonds.

text.p: The New York State Public Authorities Control Board has approved over $217 million of bonds as well as a number of smaller grants and loans for various projects, according to public documents.
The following list provides some of the details of the bond projects that were approved on Wednesday.
--$120 million of bonds for the Housing Finance Agency for a multi-family housing project in New York City.
--$18.15 million of bonds for the Housing Finance Agency for a multi-family housing project in Halfmoon.
--$11.5 million of bonds for the Dormitory Authority fr St. Mary's Hospital of Amsterdam's refinancing of Federal Housing Agency taxable debt.
--$82.4 million of advance bonded projects, out of which the state share would be around $43.2 million, for the Dormitory Authority for construction projects for the State University of New York.
--$18.2 million of bonds for the Dormitory Authority for the Manhattan Eye, Ear and Throat Hospital.
--$6.2 million of bonds for the Dormitory Authority for the state's Education Department's Cultural Education Center.
